about_the_game:
Being a protector of humanity is cool, but let’s be honest - the real fight begins inside… of You. For example when your body is fighting microbes and nasty bacterias. Have you ever wondered what it looks like in real life?

Now's your chance to find out!

Bacterian is an arcade game in which you become a red blood cell and protect your organism from all sorts of dangers that flood your microbiome. Instead of fighting them in open conflict, you must use your intelligence to reach them first in a classic, Sokoban-style way. But remember… Every second counts and the clock is ticking!

Beat more and more advanced levels and face increasing numbers of various enemies, after all you are the first and last hope for recovery. No antibiotics allowed!

Game key features ⤵️

▶️ 100 varied levels increasing difficulty diverse enemies
▶️ Cute and cool retro visuals & music
▶️ Level editor for creative players
▶️ Steam achievements & controller support
▶️ Perfect game when fighting with real flu! :)

Take care of yourself, stay healthy and play Bacterian!
